name: com.spritebridge.core
displayName: SpriteBridge — Zero-CPU GPU SpriteRenderer & 2D Animation Bridge (URP & Built-in RP)
description: Drop-in GPU Compute + RenderMeshIndirect bridge for Unity SpriteRenderer and 2D Animator on URP 14–17 (URP 3D & URP 2D) and Built-in RP. Keep 100% of Unity's native SpriteRenderer workflow, SpriteAtlas batching, Flip/Pivot/Sorting parity, GPU Bitonic Y-Sort, and an optional Zero-GameObject high-density batch API.

samples.description: Standalone 3-Phase A/B/C benchmark comparing 20,000 built-in CPU SpriteRenderers against SpriteBridge Tier 1 Drop-In (TransformAccessArray + GPU Animation + GPU Bitonic Y-Sort) and Tier 2 Zero-GameObject Batch API.
